# Empowering Investors and Startups: The Decentralized Reward Crowdfunding Method

Imagine getting involved with the best innovative projects by simply pressing a button. A world where anyone can invest in unique business ideas and, in return, get rewarded with unconventional approaches that used to be reserved for only privileged ones. Walk through an era of **reward crowdfunding**, where [blockchain](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/b/blockchain.asp), [smart contracts](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/smart-contracts-and-crowdfunding%3A-redefining-investment-opportunities), and [NFTs](https://crowdsourcingweek.com/blog/nfts-benefits-for-crowdfunding/) have reshaped how people invest. Let's dive into the world of reward crowdfunding, where new platforms are revolutionizing our thinking about investing.

**![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)**


## The Future of Reward Crowdfunding: A Smart, Transparent, and Rewarding System

The [reward crowdfunding model surpasses traditional methods](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWEgLfcpmg8) in providing **extra benefits** to investors. Previous models offered perks such as product discounts or early access when the process ends, or a project reaches its fundraising goal [[1](#ref-1)]. But what if that reward could be more than just a **physical product**? What if it could become an asset that grows in value over time and provides you with extra benefits?

This is the vision behind this platform ([Dopot](https://www.dopot.fi/)), redefining crowdfunding by adding layers of **innovation**, **security**, and **rewards**. Here's how it works: A company, like a smart glasses brand, wants to raise 1 million DAI. You, as an investor, can contribute any amount toward that goal. Once you invest, you immediately receive [fungible tokens](https://crowdsourcingweek.com/blog/nfts-benefits-for-crowdfunding/) that represent your contribution. These tokens can be refunded if the campaign doesn't reach its goal, giving you peace of mind while waiting.

In contrast, if the campaign reaches its **fundraising goal**, these fungible tokens convert into [NFTs](https://crowdsourcingweek.com/blog/nfts-benefits-for-crowdfunding/), showcasing more than a financial obligation. This converted NFT is considered a digital asset that holds real-world value. Apart from showing that you were an early **investor**, these NFTs can be traded on [secondary markets](https://www.coindesk.com/web3/2023/05/01/sothebys-launches-on-chain-secondary-nft-marketplace) and could even come with unique rewards like discounts on future products or invite-only events. Think of owning an NFT that's not just a **collectible** but a bridge to unlocking a range of **Rewards**.

This model adds a layer of **confidence** and **flexibility** to crowdfunding [that was never possible before](https://www.instagram.com/dopotfi/). It not only opens the door for you to fund **promising projects**, but you can also trade assets in the secondary market and enjoy long-term rewards. You no longer have to wait for your product to arrive. Now, you're part of an ecosystem encouraging **growth**, **trade**, and **engagement**.

## A System Built on Trust, Security, and Transparency

[Blockchain technology](https://opengeekslab.com/blog/blockchain-technology-in-crowdfunding/) lies at the heart of this platform, providing essential **transparency** and **security** in today's investment world. When you invest, every transaction is tracked and recorded on the blockchain, ensuring that everything is transparent and secure [[2](#ref-2)]. This clarifies two things: your funds can not be misused, and the project you invest in either delivers on its promises or not.

In the unfortunate event of a dispute, a [decentralized autonomous organization](https://www.investopedia.com/tech/what-dao/) (DAO) helps resolve it. The DAO comprises **community members** whose funds are at stake, and these members collectively participate in **decision-making** to resolve any conflicts [[3](#ref-3)]. This mechanism helps community members preserve the platform's integrity and mitigate any **risk of systematic manipulation.**

Moreover, the [Decentralized KYC](https://globalfintechseries.com/banking/a-complete-overview-of-decentralized-kyc-solutions/) (Know Your Customer) process is the core feature of this platform. It plays a vital role in securely identifying every participant to **maintain legitimacy** among investors and companies on the platform. Ultimately, it brings about a **safer and fraud-free environment** for investors and businesses.

## The Tokenomics: A Balanced Approach to Long-Term Growth

The platform's [tokenomics](https://www.coinbase.com/learn/wallet/tokenomics-101) model facilitates **stability** and **fairness** for investors and businesses [[4](#ref-4)]. Companies are charged a small 4% fee to launch a [new campaign](https://www.dopot.fi/assets/dopot.pdf), paid in the platform's own token, **Dopot**. This fee is divided into categories: rewarding stakes, funding the anti-fraud treasury, and supporting **liquidity** through the [Swap and Liquify](https://corporatefinanceinstitute.com/resources/cryptocurrency/liquidity-in-cryptocurrency/) function.

Its focus on long-term stability is one effort that sets this platform apart from the **industry**. Whenever new funds are invested in the platform, some fees are automatically reallocated into the [liquidity pools](https://hacken.io/discover/liquidity-pools/). No matter how many new people join the platform, this consistent stream of funds ensures the **stable value** of the token.

Moreover, companies that don't meet their fundraising goals can extend their campaigns by up to 30 days if they've raised at least 51% of their goal. This is an excellent **opportunity** for investors to continue supporting projects they believe in, giving companies more time to reach their **funding targets**.

## Vision & Mission: Empowering the Future of Reward Crowdfunding

[Dopot](https://www.dopot.fi/) has a bold **vision** in the industry: to facilitate both **entrepreneurs** and **investors**, creating a win-win situation for everyone. Their effort to diminish barriers to **traditional crowdfunding** and provide innovative opportunities deserves appreciation. Whether you're an investor looking to fund the next big idea or a company needing support, this platform offers a more **transparent, secure, and rewarding** way to participate.

The mission is to **decentralize** access to funding and investment opportunities. By combining blockchain technology, DAOs, and NFTs, Dopot is creating a system where everyone, no matter who they are, can participate in something more significant. It's about a strong community where people contribute to each other's success.

## A Look Ahead: What's next?

Dopot is now way ahead in the industry with promising **future plans**. The **equity-based** crowdfunding section, currently in **development**, will allow startups to issue [equity through DAOs](https://www.weforum.org/stories/2022/06/are-dao-the-business-structures-of-the-future/), offering a digital-first, streamlined process for investors to own a **piece of the company**. Now, people can invest in the companies they believe are the future of this world and, fortunately, own a piece of it.

Imagine you invest in the company and have the right to **vote on key decisions**; that is where Dopot's [decentralized governance](https://simple.app/blog/decentralized-governance/) is in place. This includes approving **new campaigns**, **resolving disputes**, and even shaping the future of the platform. Everyone is considered equally important in the community and has the right to participate in any matter.

In conclusion, this platform is not just about **crowdfunding** but changing how we invest, interact, and grow together. It's a place where innovation meets opportunity and where everyone has the chance to be part of something bigger. Whether you're an **investor**, a **startup**, or just someone curious about the future of crowdfunding, this platform offers a new way forward, one that's **transparent**, **secure**, and full of potential. The future of crowdfunding is here, and it's **decentralized**.
